item.title: A new space
item.author: goatstowerblog@proton.me (Goat)
item.content:encoded:
I’m Goat. I made this blog to get into the habit of writing more things.

Here are some things you might see here in the future:

  • Opinions about various things
  • Short stories and fiction
  • Solo tabletop RPG sessions and related posts

Stick around if you’re interested.
